manual.name: Manual trigger
manual.description: Starts the workflow when the user clicks Run. The input form is generated from the trigger's input schema.

webhook.name: Webhook trigger
webhook.description: Starts the workflow when an HTTP request is received on the configured path and method.

schedule.name: Schedule trigger
schedule.description: Starts the workflow on a cron-like schedule with timezone support.

event.name: Event trigger
event.description: Starts the workflow when an event is published on the configured internal event bus topic.

form.name: Form trigger
form.description: Starts the workflow when a generated form is submitted. Field definitions drive the form schema.

chat.name: Chat trigger
chat.description: Starts the workflow when a chat message is received. Emits message, sessionId, and userId.

if.name: If
if.description: Conditional branch. Evaluates the configured condition and routes the input to the matching output.

switch.name: Switch
switch.description: Multi-branch switch. Routes the input to the first matching case output, or the default output.

error_boundary.name: Error boundary
error_boundary.description: Wraps the input in a try/catch/finally. Emits the result on success, or the error on failure.

human_approval.name: Human approval
human_approval.description: Suspends execution until a human approves or rejects. Emits the approved value or a rejection.

break.name: Break
break.description: Breaks out of the enclosing loop. The loop terminates early and returns the results collected so far.

value.label: Value
value.placeholder: Value to forward (collected as the last partial result)

value.label: Value
value.placeholder: Value to forward (collected as the last partial result)

map.name: Map
map.description: Transforms the current input into a new output object using the configured mapper.

delay.name: Delay
delay.description: Pauses execution for the configured duration (in milliseconds), then forwards the input unchanged.

code.name: Code
code.description: Runs user-authored JS/TS in a restricted VM sandbox. Supports placeholder syntax for workflow data references.

defaultCode.label: Default code
defaultCode.placeholder: Code run when no code input is connected

log.name: Log
log.description: Logs the input value to the execution logger and forwards it unchanged.

utility_log.name: Utility Log
utility_log.description: Logs the input value to the run's ctx.logger at a configurable level and forwards it unchanged.

foreach.name: Foreach loop
foreach.description: Iterates over an array input and executes the body once per item (or per slice of items).

while.name: While loop
while.description: Repeats the body while the condition is true (pre-condition).

until.name: Until loop
until.description: Repeats the body until the condition is true (post-condition, runs at least once).

agent.name: Agent
agent.description: AI agent that orchestrates a model, memory, and workspace to complete a task.

tool.name: Tool
tool.description: Supplies one configured mastra tool to the agent's tools zone.

tool_selector.name: Tool selector
tool_selector.description: Selects one connected tool from a decision input.

hook.name: Tool hook
hook.description: Represents a before/after tool call hook and routes its context into a sub-flow.

tool_deny.name: Tool deny
tool_deny.description: Denies a tool call from inside a hook before-sub-flow.

delegation_hook.name: Delegation hook
delegation_hook.description: Represents an onDelegationStart/onDelegationComplete hook for a sub-agent.

skill.name: Skill
skill.description: Supplies one configured skill to the agent's skill zone.

skill_selector.name: Skill selector
skill_selector.description: Selects one connected skill from a decision input.

sandbox.name: Sandbox
sandbox.description: Supplies a configured sandbox/filesystem resource to the agent's sandbox zone.

scorer.name: Scorer
scorer.description: Supplies one configured scorer to the agent's scorers zone.

scorer_selector.name: Scorer selector
scorer_selector.description: Selects one connected scorer from a decision input.

memory.name: Memory
memory.description: Supplies a configured mastra memory (conversation history, semantic recall, working memory) to the agent's memory zone.

workingMemoryTemplate.label: Working memory template
workingMemoryTemplate.placeholder: Working memory template, e.g. User name: {{name}}

memory_selector.name: Memory selector
memory_selector.description: Selects one connected memory from a decision input.

embedding.name: Embedding
embedding.description: Supplies a configured embedding model to the agent's embedding zone.

vector_store.name: Vector store
vector_store.description: Supplies a configured RAG vector store to a retriever.

retriever.name: Retriever
retriever.description: Retrieves documents from a configured vector store.

chunking.name: Chunking
chunking.description: Splits documents/text into overlapping chunks for RAG.

rerank.name: Rerank
rerank.description: Reorders candidate documents by relevance to a query.

qa.name: Q&A chain
qa.description: Answers a query from retrieved context.

basic.name: Basic LLM chain
basic.description: Runs a single prompt against a configured model.

summarization.name: Summarization chain
summarization.description: Summarizes documents/text with a configured model.

structured_output_parser.name: Structured output parser
structured_output_parser.description: Parses model text into the declared structured shape.

information_extractor.name: Information extractor
information_extractor.description: Extracts declared structured fields out of text.

langchain_code.name: LangChain code
langchain_code.description: User-authored AI glue compiled into a mastra step.

input_processor.name: Input processor
input_processor.description: Supplies one configured mastra input processor (preprocessor) to the agent's input-processors zone.

output_processor.name: Output processor
output_processor.description: Supplies one configured mastra output processor (post-processor) to the agent's output-processors zone.

guardrail.name: Guardrail
guardrail.description: Intercepts invalid model output on the agent's output-processors zone; block strategy aborts via mastra's tripwire.

hitl.name: Human in the loop
hitl.description: Suspends the workflow until a user supplies the requested input, then resumes through the mastra resume path.

prompt.label: Prompt
prompt.placeholder: The question asked to the user

resumeSchema.label: Resume schema
resumeSchema.placeholder: Shape of the user input, declared via the model builder

mcp_trigger.name: MCP Server Trigger
mcp_trigger.description: Exposes the enclosing workflow as an MCP server through the host-supplied mastra MCP server surface.

serverId.label: Server id
serverId.placeholder: Unique MCP server id exposed to clients

slack_trigger.name: Slack trigger
slack_trigger.description: Receives an inbound Slack conversation message and carries the thread binding so the reply lands in the same conversation.

discord_trigger.name: Discord trigger
discord_trigger.description: Receives an inbound Discord conversation message and carries the thread binding so the reply lands in the same conversation.

telegram_trigger.name: Telegram trigger
telegram_trigger.description: Receives an inbound Telegram conversation message and carries the thread binding so the reply lands in the same conversation.

teams_trigger.name: Teams trigger
teams_trigger.description: Receives an inbound Teams conversation message and carries the thread binding so the reply lands in the same conversation.

slack_response.name: Slack response
slack_response.description: Posts the agent's reply back to the Slack conversation the trigger received it from.

discord_response.name: Discord response
discord_response.description: Posts the agent's reply back to the Discord conversation the trigger received it from.

telegram_response.name: Telegram response
telegram_response.description: Posts the agent's reply back to the Telegram conversation the trigger received it from.

teams_response.name: Teams response
teams_response.description: Posts the agent's reply back to the Teams conversation the trigger received it from.

voice.name: Voice
voice.description: Resolves the mastra voice surface for the configured voice through the host-supplied voice factory.

input.name: Workflow input value
input.description: Reusable canvas value node representing a workflow input.

output.name: Workflow output value
output.description: Terminal canvas node that receives the workflow output.
